name: Flex.Item
description: Child item component for Flex layout container with grow, shrink, and width span controls.

props.name: as
props.description: Custom HTML tag or component to render.

props.name: grow
props.description: Allows flex item to expand and absorb all remaining row space.

props.name: shrink
props.description: Set to false to prevent flex item from shrinking under space pressure.
